title: Ceph管理keyring为何不应直接交给普通RBD应用？
answer: 管理能力远超镜像读写需求，一次泄露可影响全集群。按客户端所需pool、namespace和监视访问配置最小权限，验收越界操作拒绝及密钥轮换。
source: OpsForge 原创编审 2026-10-21；Ceph Squid 官方文档核对
review_note: 逐题文本编审，核对机制与验收边界；未在生产执行，未宣称实机验证。 作者候选，真实Cephx/RBD验证与独审待完成。
body:
## 操作任务
给普通RBD应用配置独立Cephx身份，不能复制管理keyring或授予全集群管理能力。实现provision(mon,entity,pool,namespace,keyring)：mon是既有私有管理客户端的原生MON命令接口，entity/pool/namespace/目标keyring均为本题新建owned范围。创建允许该pool指定namespace中RBD镜像读写的独立身份，MON仅所需RBD访问能力。将真实密钥写入给定keyring（0600），返回{entity,keyring:路径字符串,pool,namespace,default_admin_changed:False}。相同identity/scope重复调用应保留同一有效密钥。不能改管理身份caps、管理keyring、默认config或其他客户端。
实现rotate(mon,old_entity,new_entity,pool,namespace,keyring,probe)：先配置新的独立同范围身份及keyring；通过probe(new_entity,keyring)取得真实新客户端连接、RBD读写和越界拒绝的就绪证明，只有返回严格bool True后才删除old_entity。新身份就绪失败必须ValueError并保留原身份与可用权限，不能先吊销再试部署。成功返回{new_entity,old_entity_removed:True,fresh_auth_required:True,existing_session_revocation_guaranteed:False}。
## 产物
task.py。所有客户端和keyring只在本题throwaway集群创建、轮换及吊销。原生验证分别覆盖指定pool/namespace内RBD读写、同pool另一namespace拒绝、另一pool拒绝、创建pool等MON管理操作拒绝。不能用本地字典caps、字符串对照或模拟认证代替原生Cephx权限行为。
## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py。真实私有Ceph19.2.3 MON+OSD启用Cephx。变更前记录管理keyring/config哈希及admin caps和旧租户RBD读写基线；变更后使用原管理身份的新连接重新验证这些权限与访问方式全部保留，同时验证新增身份的实际范围。对轮换模拟“新部署误用别的namespace”的真实权限拒绝，确保旧身份仍可用；正确部署后新身份同范围通过，旧keyring的fresh authentication被拒；同时保留MON实体不存在及原生Cephx负面认证回复、对照fresh新身份/admin成功，不能把纯连接超时当权限拒绝。
## 能力与风险边界
管理keyring泄露可越过应用边界影响全集群，应用身份应按pool/namespace/所需MON访问分离并轮换。本机librados的connect(timeout=...)原生文档明确参数被忽略，因此fresh坏凭据探针用独立子进程硬期限并显式client_mount_timeout=3，要求负面认证回复而非纯超时。删除Cephx实体后既有ticket/session可能仍在有效期内；本题记录held旧连接的实际结果，不承诺立即让全部已连接会话失效。泄露处置若要求立即隔离，必须另行评估客户端连接隔离/blocklist与票据有效期；不能只看到auth del成功就宣称泄露影响消失。本题仅在自有测试集群创建新身份并验证轮换，不接触真实默认keyring、账号、PATH或外部集群，不验证生产多MON故障或外部密钥分发系统。
rubric: 准确解释题设机制与前提
提供对应证据、验收结果及必要风险边界

"""Experimental nonroot, private MON/memstore OSD; no question or incident credit."""
import json,os,pathlib,socket,subprocess,tempfile,time,uuid
import rados

def record_native(row):
 with (pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks/native-commands.jsonl').open('a',encoding='utf8')as f:f.write(json.dumps(row,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
assert os.geteuid()==1000
TOOL=pathlib.Path('/tmp/opsforge-session07-20261029/native')
ENV={**os.environ,'LD_LIBRARY_PATH':str(TOOL/'usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ceph')+':'+str(TOOL/'usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu')+':'+str(TOOL/'lib/x86_64-linux-gnu'),'PYTHONPATH':str(TOOL/'usr/lib/python3/dist-packages')}
def command(name,*args,timeout=20):
 result=subprocess.run([str(TOOL/'usr/bin'/name),*map(str,args)],env=ENV,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
 record_native({'argv':result.args,'returncode':result.returncode,'stdout':result.stdout,'stderr':result.stderr})
 if result.returncode:raise RuntimeError(name+' private command failed: '+result.stdout[-1000:]+result.stderr[-3000:])
 return result.stdout
def port():
 with socket.socket() as endpoint:endpoint.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));return endpoint.getsockname()[1]
class PrivateCeph:
 def __enter__(self):
  self.temp=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-session07-ceph-');self.root=pathlib.Path(self.temp.name);self.processes=[];self.logs=[];self.client=None
  try:
   self.fsid=str(uuid.uuid4());self.monport=port();self.config=self.root/'ceph.conf';self.monmap=self.root/'monmap';self.mondata=self.root/'mon.a';self.mondata.mkdir()
   (self.root/'run').mkdir();(self.root/'crash').mkdir()
   self.config.write_text('''[global]
plugin dir = {tool}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ceph
mon cluster log file = {root}/cluster.log
mon cluster log to file = false
fsid = {fsid}
mon initial members = a
mon host = 127.0.0.1:{port}
auth cluster required = cephx
auth service required = cephx
auth client required = cephx
public addr = 127.0.0.1
cluster addr = 127.0.0.1
ms bind ipv4 = true
ms bind ipv6 = false
ms async op threads = 1
log to stderr = true
log to file = false
run dir = {root}/run
crash dir = {root}/crash
erasure code dir = {tool}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ceph/erasure-code
osd class dir = {tool}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/rados-classes
admin socket = {root}/$name.asok
pid file = {root}/$name.pid
keyring = {root}/$name.keyring
mon data avail crit = 0
mon data avail warn = 0
mon allow pool delete = true
mon allow pool size one = true
osd pool default size = 1
osd pool default min size = 1
osd pool default pg num = 1
osd pool default pgp num = 1
osd pool default pg autoscale mode = off
osd crush chooseleaf type = 0
rados mon op timeout = 3
rados osd op timeout = 3
[mon.a]
debug auth = 10
mon data = {root}/mon.a
mon addr = 127.0.0.1:{port}
[osd]
osd objectstore = memstore
osd data = {root}/osd.$id
keyring = {root}/osd.$id/keyring
osd memory target = 134217728
memstore device bytes = 134217728
osd op num shards = 1
osd op num threads per shard = 1
osd op num shards hdd = 1
osd op num threads per shard hdd = 1
osd op num shards ssd = 1
osd op num threads per shard ssd = 1
osd recovery max active = 1
osd max backfills = 1
osd class dir = {tool}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/rados-classes
erasure code dir = {tool}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ceph/erasure-code
'''.format(fsid=self.fsid,port=self.monport,root=self.root,tool=TOOL))
   command('monmaptool','--create','--fsid',self.fsid,'--add','a','127.0.0.1:'+str(self.monport),self.monmap)
   command('ceph-authtool','--create-keyring',self.root/'mon.keyring','--gen-key','-n','mon.')
   command('ceph-authtool','--create-keyring',self.root/'client.admin.keyring','--gen-key','-n','client.admin','--cap','mon','allow *','--cap','osd','allow *','--cap','mgr','allow *')
   command('ceph-authtool',self.root/'mon.keyring','--import-keyring',self.root/'client.admin.keyring')
   command('ceph-mon','--mkfs','-i','a','-c',self.config,'--monmap',self.monmap,'--mon-data',self.mondata,'--keyring',self.root/'mon.keyring')
   monitor=self.start('ceph-mon','--keyring',self.root/'mon.keyring','-f','-i','a','-c',self.config,'--mon-data',self.mondata,'--setuser','1000','--setgroup','1000')
   deadline=time.monotonic()+20;last=None
   while time.monotonic()<deadline:
    if monitor.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('private MON exited before readiness: '+self.log_tail())
    try:
     status=json.loads(command('ceph','--admin-daemon',self.root/'mon.a.asok','mon_status',timeout=3))
     if status.get('state') not in ('leader','peon'):time.sleep(.2);continue
     assert status['monmap']['fsid']==self.fsid;break
    except Exception as error:
     last=error
     time.sleep(.2)
   else:raise RuntimeError('private MON readiness failed: '+str(last)+' '+self.log_tail())
   print('NATIVE_PRIVATE_CEPH_MON_READY '+json.dumps({'fsid':self.fsid,'uid':os.geteuid(),'quorum':status.get('quorum'),'network':'none-loopback-only'}),flush=True)
   self.client=rados.Rados(conffile=str(self.config),name='client.admin');self.client.connect(timeout=3)
   return self
  except BaseException:self.__exit__(None,None,None);raise
 def start(self,name,*args):
  log=(self.root/(name+'-'+str(len(self.processes))+'.log')).open('wb');self.logs.append(log)
  process=subprocess.Popen([str(TOOL/'usr/bin'/name),*map(str,args)],env=ENV,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=log,stderr=log);self.processes.append(process)
  record_native({'event':'process_start','pid':process.pid,'argv':process.args,'owned_root':str(self.root)})
  return process
 def mon(self,prefix,**kwargs):
  rc,out,err=self.client.mon_command(json.dumps({'prefix':prefix,'format':'json',**kwargs}),b'')
  record_native({'mon_command':{'prefix':prefix,'format':'json',**kwargs},'rc':rc,'stdout':out.decode(errors='replace'),'stderr':err})
  if rc:raise RuntimeError('private mon command '+prefix+' failed: '+str(rc)+' '+str(err))
  try:return json.loads(out)
  except json.JSONDecodeError:return out.decode().strip()
 def add_osd(self):
  osduuid=str(uuid.uuid4());created=self.mon('osd create',uuid=osduuid);osdid=int(created['osdid'] if isinstance(created,dict) else created);data=self.root/('osd.'+str(osdid));data.mkdir()
  credentials=self.mon('auth get-or-create',entity='osd.'+str(osdid),caps=['mon','allow profile osd','osd','allow *','mgr','allow profile osd'])
  (data/'keyring').write_text('[osd.'+str(osdid)+']\n key = '+credentials[0]['key']+'\n')
  command('ceph-osd','--mkfs','--mkkey','-i',osdid,'-c',self.config,'--osd-uuid',osduuid,'--osd-data',data,'--osd-objectstore','memstore','--setuser','1000','--setgroup','1000')
  process=self.start('ceph-osd','-f','-i',osdid,'-c',self.config,'--osd-data',data,'--osd-objectstore','memstore','--setuser','1000','--setgroup','1000')
  deadline=time.monotonic()+20
  while time.monotonic()<deadline:
   if process.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('private OSD exited: '+self.log_tail())
   status=self.mon('osd dump');row=next((row for row in status['osds'] if row['osd']==osdid),None)
   if row and row['up']==1 and row['in']==1:break
   time.sleep(.2)
  else:raise RuntimeError('private OSD readiness timeout: '+self.log_tail())
  print('NATIVE_PRIVATE_CEPH_MEMSTORE_OSD_READY '+str(osdid),flush=True);return osdid
 def log_tail(self):
  return '\n'.join(path.read_text(errors='replace')[-2500:] for path in self.root.glob('*.log'))
 def __exit__(self,*args):
  if self.client:
   try:self.client.shutdown()
   except Exception:pass
  for process in reversed(self.processes):
   if process.poll() is None:process.terminate()
   try:process.wait(timeout=8)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:process.kill();process.wait(timeout=3)
  for log in self.logs:log.close()
  self.temp.cleanup()
  record_native({'event':'cleanup','owned_root':str(self.root),'root_exists':self.root.exists(),'processes':[{'pid':p.pid,'returncode':p.poll()}for p in self.processes]})

import copy,errno,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,secrets,stat,sys,subprocess,rados,rbd
sys.path[:0]=[str(pathlib.Path.cwd()),str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks')]
from cephx_native import PrivateCeph,record_native
import task
assert os.geteuid()==1000
with PrivateCeph()as c:
 c.add_osd();pool='owned_keyring_'+secrets.token_hex(3);other_pool='owned_other_'+secrets.token_hex(3);scope='tenant_b_'+secrets.token_hex(3);other_ns='tenant_a_'+secrets.token_hex(3);api=rbd.RBD();size=1024*1024
 for owned in (pool,other_pool):c.client.create_pool(owned)
 for owned,ns in ((pool,scope),(pool,other_ns),(other_pool,scope)):
  with c.client.open_ioctx(owned)as io:
   api.namespace_create(io,ns);io.set_namespace(ns);api.create(io,'volume',size,old_format=False,features=rbd.RBD_FEATURE_LAYERING)
   with rbd.Image(io,'volume')as image:image.write(b'BASELINE:'+owned.encode()+b':'+ns.encode(),0);image.flush()
 admin_keyring=c.root/'client.admin.keyring';admin_bytes=admin_keyring.read_bytes();config_bytes=c.config.read_bytes();admin_auth=copy.deepcopy(c.mon('auth get',entity='client.admin'))
 def connect(entity,keyring=None):
  conf={'client_mount_timeout':'3','admin_socket':''};conf.update({'keyring':str(keyring)}if keyring else {});client=rados.Rados(conffile=str(c.config),name=entity,conf=conf);client.connect(timeout=3);return client
 def readwrite(client,owned,ns):
  with client.open_ioctx(owned)as io:
   io.set_namespace(ns)
   with rbd.Image(io,'volume')as image:
    payload=secrets.token_bytes(4096);image.write(payload,4096);image.flush();assert image.read(4096,4096)==payload;record_native({'event':'actual_rbd_readwrite','pool':owned,'namespace':ns,'offset':4096,'bytes':4096,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()})
 def denied(client,owned,ns):
  try:
   with client.open_ioctx(owned)as io:
    io.set_namespace(ns)
    with rbd.Image(io,'volume')as image:image.read(0,32)
  except (rados.PermissionError,rados.PermissionDeniedError,rbd.PermissionError):return True
  return False
 def verify_admin():
  assert admin_keyring.read_bytes()==admin_bytes and c.config.read_bytes()==config_bytes,'default private admin keyring/config changed'
  assert c.mon('auth get',entity='client.admin')==admin_auth,'admin caps/key changed'
  fresh=connect('client.admin')
  try:
   for owned,ns in ((pool,scope),(pool,other_ns),(other_pool,scope)):readwrite(fresh,owned,ns)
   rc,out,err=fresh.mon_command(json.dumps({'prefix':'osd dump','format':'json'}),b'');assert rc==0
  finally:fresh.shutdown()
 verify_admin();old='client.app_'+secrets.token_hex(4);old_key=c.root/(old+'.keyring')
 for attempt in range(2):
  try:result=task.provision(c.mon,old,pool,scope,old_key)
  except Exception as e:raise AssertionError('valid new application provisioning failed')from e
  assert result=={'entity':old,'keyring':str(old_key),'pool':pool,'namespace':scope,'default_admin_changed':False}and result['default_admin_changed']is False
  assert stat.S_IMODE(old_key.stat().st_mode)==0o600,'application keyring is readable outside owner'
  current_key=old_key.read_bytes()
  if attempt:assert current_key==previous_key,'repeated provisioning rotated key unexpectedly'
  previous_key=current_key;verify_admin()
 held=connect(old,old_key)
 def check_scoped(entity,keyring,wrong_deployment=False):
  client=connect(entity,keyring)
  try:
   if wrong_deployment:return not denied(client,pool,other_ns)
   readwrite(client,pool,scope)
   other_namespace_denied=denied(client,pool,other_ns);other_pool_denied=denied(client,other_pool,scope);record_native({'event':'actual_rbd_scope_denials','entity':entity,'other_namespace_denied':other_namespace_denied,'other_pool_denied':other_pool_denied})
   assert other_namespace_denied,'application read another namespace'
   assert other_pool_denied,'application read another pool'
   rc,out,err=client.mon_command(json.dumps({'prefix':'osd pool create','pool':'unauthorized_pool','pg_num':1,'format':'json'}),b'');assert rc in (-errno.EACCES,-errno.EPERM),'application can create pools or rejection was not authorization denial'
   record_native({'client_mon_command':{'entity':entity,'prefix':'osd pool create','pool':'unauthorized_pool','pg_num':1},'rc':rc,'stdout':out.decode(errors='replace'),'stderr':err})
   secret_rc,secret_out,secret_err=client.mon_command(json.dumps({'prefix':'auth get','entity':'client.admin','format':'json'}),b'');record_native({'client_mon_command':{'entity':entity,'prefix':'auth get','target_entity':'client.admin'},'rc':secret_rc,'stderr':secret_err})
   assert secret_rc in (-errno.EACCES,-errno.EPERM),'application can read management credentials or denial was not authorization'
   return True
  finally:client.shutdown()
 assert check_scoped(old,old_key)is True;new='client.rotated_'+secrets.token_hex(4);new_key=c.root/(new+'.keyring')
 try:
  try:task.rotate(c.mon,old,new,pool,scope,new_key,lambda entity,key:check_scoped(entity,key,wrong_deployment=True))
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('wrong-namespace readiness failure did not stop old credential revocation')
  old_rc,old_out,old_err=c.client.mon_command(json.dumps({'prefix':'auth get','entity':old,'format':'json'}),b'');assert old_rc==0,'old identity removed before new deployment ready';assert check_scoped(old,old_key)is True;verify_admin()
  def truthy_not_bool(entity,key):
   assert check_scoped(entity,key)is True
   return 1
  try:task.rotate(c.mon,old,new,pool,scope,new_key,truthy_not_bool)
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('integer readiness accepted as strict bool True')
  old_rc,old_out,old_err=c.client.mon_command(json.dumps({'prefix':'auth get','entity':old,'format':'json'}),b'');assert old_rc==0,'old identity removed on non-bool readiness';assert check_scoped(old,old_key)is True;verify_admin()
  try:report=task.rotate(c.mon,old,new,pool,scope,new_key,check_scoped)
  except Exception as e:raise AssertionError('validated native identity rotation failed')from e
  assert report=={'new_entity':new,'old_entity_removed':True,'fresh_auth_required':True,'existing_session_revocation_guaranteed':False}
  assert report['old_entity_removed']is True and report['fresh_auth_required']is True and report['existing_session_revocation_guaranteed']is False
  assert check_scoped(new,new_key)is True;verify_admin()
  rc,out,err=c.client.mon_command(json.dumps({'prefix':'auth get','entity':old,'format':'json'}),b'');assert rc==-errno.ENOENT,'old Cephx auth entity not removed'
  fresh_code="import pathlib,sys,rados;c=rados.Rados(conffile=sys.argv[1],name=sys.argv[2],conf={'keyring':sys.argv[3],'client_mount_timeout':'3','admin_socket':''});c.connect();print('AUTH_CONNECTED',flush=True);c.shutdown()"
  argv=[sys.executable,'-B','-c',fresh_code,str(c.config),old,str(old_key)]
  try:
   fresh_result=subprocess.run(argv,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=6);fresh_stdout=fresh_result.stdout;fresh_stderr=fresh_result.stderr;fresh_rc=fresh_result.returncode;outer_deadline=False
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e:
   fresh_stdout=(e.stdout or b'').decode(errors='replace')if isinstance(e.stdout,(bytes,type(None)))else e.stdout;fresh_stderr=(e.stderr or b'').decode(errors='replace')if isinstance(e.stderr,(bytes,type(None)))else e.stderr;fresh_rc=None;outer_deadline=True
  mon_auth_lines=[line for log in c.root.glob('ceph-mon-*.log')for line in log.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines()if old in line]
  record_native({'event':'fresh_revoked_auth_probe','argv':argv,'returncode':fresh_rc,'outer_deadline':outer_deadline,'stdout':fresh_stdout,'stderr':fresh_stderr,'mon_auth_entity_lookup_rc':rc,'mon_auth_lines':mon_auth_lines})
  assert 'AUTH_CONNECTED'not in fresh_stdout and fresh_rc!=0,'old keyring still authenticates new client after revocation'
  assert 'handle_auth_bad_method'in fresh_stderr or 'PermissionDenied'in fresh_stderr or 'PermissionError'in fresh_stderr,'pure timeout/connection failure cannot establish auth rejection'
  fresh_rejected=True
  try:readwrite(held,pool,scope);held_allowed=True
  except (rados.Error,rbd.Error):held_allowed=False
  record_native({'event':'scoped_app_rotation_original_admin_preserved','new_entity':new,'pool':pool,'namespace':scope,'old_fresh_auth_rejected':fresh_rejected,'held_old_session_observed_allowed':held_allowed,'held_sessions_immediately_revoked_guaranteed':False,'admin_keyring_sha256':hashlib.sha256(admin_bytes).hexdigest(),'default_config_sha256':hashlib.sha256(config_bytes).hexdigest()})
 finally:held.shutdown()
 for entity in (new,):c.mon('auth del',entity=entity)
 for owned in (pool,other_pool):c.client.delete_pool(owned)
assert not c.root.exists()and all(process.poll()is not None for process in c.processes),'owned cluster resource leak'
